Class ContactSelector

public inherited sharing class ContactSelector

Selector class for the Contact object. Provides centralized SOQL query methods for retrieving contacts by Id, set of Ids, or email address. Returns results wrapped in a Result inner class extending Tools.QueryResult.

Group:
    Selector Classes

Since:
    08/10/2021

Version:
    1.3


Change Log

  • 08/10/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version
  • 10/17/2023 - v1.1 - Added getContactsByEmail() to query contacts by email address
  • 08/30/2024 - v1.2 - Overloaded getContactsByEmail() to accept a single email or a list of emails
  • 03/19/2026 - v1.3 - Added getContactById() to retrieve a single Contact with related Account fields
